english.title: Housing Wales Act licence holder fail to notify licensing authority of changes
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the holder of a licence granted under section 18 of the Housing (Wales) Act 2014, without reasonable excuse, failed to notify the licensing authority in writing of

(A)_[a change in the name under which you were licensed]_
(B)_[a prescribed change, namely **(..SPECIFY CHANGE..),]_

within 28 days beginning with the first day on which you knew, or should have known, of the change
english.legislation: Contrary to section 23(3) of the Housing (Wales) Act 2014.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
licence holder must notify the licensing authority

any change in the name under which the licence holder is licensed
any prescribed changes
within 28 days
beginning with the first day on which the licence holder knew, or should have known, of the change

english.standardstatementoffacts:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) the defendant, being the holder of a licence granted under section 18 of the Housing (Wales) Act 2014, without reasonable excuse, failed to notify the licensing authority in writing of

(A)_[a change in the name under which he was licensed]_
(B)_[a change in the name under which she was licensed]_
(C)_[a change in the name under which it was licensed]_
(D)_[a prescribed change, namely **(..SPECIFY CHANGE..),]_

within 28 days beginning with the first day on which

(E)_[he]_
(F)_[she]_
(G)_[it]_

knew, or should have known, of the change.
